description: This file defines an abstract class 'MessagingOptions' that encapsulates global messaging configuration settings for Orleans, including timeout durations, message size limits, and cancellation policies.

classes.name: MessagingOptions
classes.description: An abstract class providing configurable messaging options for Orleans, including response timeouts, message size limits, and cancellation behaviors.

methods.name: ResponseTimeout
methods.description: Gets or sets the default response timeout, which varies depending on whether a debugger is attached.

methods.name: ResponseTimeoutWithDebugger
methods.description: Gets or sets the response timeout duration when a debugger is attached; defaults to 30 minutes.

methods.name: ConfiguredResponseTimeout
methods.description: Returns the response timeout value without debugger checks.
